images.name: Space Station Sector Map
images.description: Classic hand-drawn sector map suitable for Stars Without Number space exploration. Grid-based layout with docking bays and corridors.
images.attribution: Map by Dyson Logos (dysonlogos.blog). Free for personal use. See https://dysonlogos.blog/maps/the-free-maps-of-dyson-logos/ for full terms.

images.name: Abandoned Mining Facility
images.description: Multi-level abandoned industrial complex. Perfect for SWN delve sessions or CWN urban ruins exploration.
images.attribution: Map by Dyson Logos (dysonlogos.blog). Free for personal use.

images.name: Alien Jungle Planet Surface
images.description: Hand-drawn wilderness overland map with alien flora, rivers, and ruins. Ideal for SWN planet-fall scenarios.
images.attribution: Map by Dyson Logos (dysonlogos.blog). Free for personal use.

images.name: Starship Deck Plan - Frigate Class
images.description: Detailed deck plan for a mid-size frigate. Includes bridge, crew quarters, cargo hold, and engine room. VTT-ready.
images.attribution: Generated via donjon.bin.sh random dungeon generator. Public domain. https://donjon.bin.sh/

images.name: City Street Grid - Cyberpunk District
images.description: Urban street grid for Cities Without Number. Features alleyways, market stalls, and multi-story buildings footprints.
images.attribution: City map generated with Watabou's City Generator (watabou.itch.io). Free for personal/non-commercial use.

images.name: Ancient Alien Ruins - Precursor Site
images.description: Mysterious non-human architecture. Ideal for Mandate-era Precursor ruins in SWN.
images.attribution: Map by Dyson Logos (dysonlogos.blog). Free for personal use.

images.name: Underground Bunker Complex
images.description: Cold-war style underground bunker adapted for sci-fi. Multiple blast doors, armory, command center.
images.attribution: Map by Dyson Logos (dysonlogos.blog). Free for personal use.

images.name: One Page Dungeon - Derelict Cargo Hauler
images.description: Award-winning one-page dungeon adapted for SWN. A derelict cargo hauler drifting near a gas giant.
images.artist: One Page Dungeon Contest (various, CC BY)
images.attribution: One Page Dungeon Contest entry. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. https://1pdcamp.itch.io/

images.name: Scifi Soldier - Female Operative
images.description: Armored female operative in tactical gear. Suitable for SWN Warriors or Experts.
images.attribution: Portrait by Justin Nichol. CC0 Public Domain. Source: https://opengameart.org/users/justin-nichol

images.name: Alien Diplomat - Non-Human NPC
images.description: Striking non-human alien in formal attire. Great for alien NPCs in SWN first-contact scenarios.
images.attribution: Portrait from OpenGameArt.org. CC BY 3.0. See source page for individual artist credit.

images.name: Street Fixer - Male CWN Contact
images.description: Grizzled middle-aged street fixer in a long coat. Perfect for CWN fixers, contacts, or veteran operatives.

images.name: Psychic Adept - Female
images.description: Young woman in meditative pose with subtle psychic energy effects. Ideal for SWN Psychic characters.
images.attribution: Portrait from OpenGameArt.org. CC0 Public Domain.

images.name: Ship Captain - Veteran Spacer
images.description: Weathered starship captain in worn uniform with captain's insignia. Great for SWN ship crew portraits.

images.name: Corporate Agent - CWN Antagonist
images.description: Sharp-suited corporate operative with cold expression. Perfect CWN faction NPC or antagonist.

images.name: Free Merchant - Traveller NPC

images.attribution: Portrait from OpenGameArt.org. CC0 Public Domain.
